questions.problem: The vector $a$ has magnitude $7,$ the vector $b$ has magnitude $3,$ the angle between $a$ and $b$ is ${55}^{∘}$ and $n$ is the unit vector that points in the direction of $a\times b.$ Find $a\times b$ in terms of $n.$ Round your final answer to the nearest integer where appropriate.
questions.worked_solution:
We use the formula for the cross product and obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}a\times b & =|a|\cdot |b|\cdot \operatorname{sin}⁡\theta \cdot n \\  & =7\cdot 3\cdot \operatorname{sin}⁡{55}^{∘}\cdot n \\  & =21(0.819…)\cdot n \\  & =(17.202…)\cdot n \\  & ≈17n.\end{aligned}
$$

questions.problem: The vector $a$ has magnitude $5,$ the vector $b$ has magnitude $2,$ and $a∥b.$ Find $a\times b.$
questions.worked_solution:
Suppose $a$ and $b$ are nonzero vectors. Then, $a\times b=0$ if and only if $a∥b.$

Therefore, $a\times b=0.$
